Yogi Adityanath claims UP shed 'identity crisis' under BJP rule

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath stated that Mainpuri residents faced an 'identity crisis' before 2017. He asserted that under BJP rule, Uttar Pradesh has shed this crisis and is now an 'Utsav Pradesh' (Festival State). Adityanath made these remarks while campaigning in Mainpuri, targeting the Samajwadi Party. He also claimed that Etawah no longer evokes fear.
